notes_for_editor: Only survey records (1936 first observation, 1963 USGS recovery note) and the statewide list give dates or descriptions. No build date, builder, design, height, staffing, access, or fire history found in two web searches and the pages read. The Forest Lookouts page reproduces the NGS datasheet, so it adds no independent record. Survey height is the station's NAVD 88 height, not the tower's height. The 1936 and 1963 events are survey observations, so they are typed as assessed rather than built.
